title: Thanksgiving at The Garrison
seo_title: Thanksgiving Buffet at The Garrison | Nov 26, 2026
description: This is a Thanksgiving dining event at The Garrison, beneath The Ozark Mill, with a chef-curated buffet that includes smoked prime rib, citrus-brined turkey, fresh seafood, artisan cheeses, seasonal sides, and a dessert display. Guests go through the buffet in the Riverside Room, then are seated in The Garrison, where drinks are available for purchase, including a full cocktail menu. It takes place Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM; reservations are required and open October 12 at 10:00 AM.
